annotations.title: Not man but God.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> He that deſpiſeth the Churches or her lavvful Paſtors precepts, offendeth no leſſe then if he contemned Gods expreſſe commaundements. For they be of the holy Ghoſt, and are not to be counted among the commaundements of men onely.

annotations.title: Sleepe.
annotations.text: Some Heretikes peruerſly inferred of this that the ſoules did ſleepe til the day of iudgement: vvhere it is meant of the bodies onely.
